title: decode() should delegate to decode_limited(input, None) — eliminates 110-line duplication
description: decode() and decode_limited() share ~110 lines of identical logic: lines-splitting, begin_idx search, begin-base64 detection, begin-line parsing, mode/filename extraction, data-line loop structure. decode() could be implemented as decode_limited(input, None) — the limit checks (data.len() >= usize::MAX) are trivially false and will be eliminated at compile time. Not doing this means every future fix to begin-line detection, mode parsing, or data decoding must be applied twice. This has already been a source of bugs (the begin-line detection between scan and decode was divergent for multiple passes). The first time a fix lands in decode() but not decode_limited(), or vice versa, it will produce a silent correctness bug for callers of the missed path.
close_reason: decode() now delegates to decode_limited(input, None). Removed ~110-line duplicate. Single code path.
